inventory.webhookApiVersion: Not verified from the deployed endpoint configuration

inventory.upgradeAssessment: Test PaymentIntent and webhook behaviour against the effective Stripe API and endpoint versions before SDK or API upgrades.

paymentPageScripts.evidence: Source review and runtime header observation R-01

paymentPageScripts.paymentImpact: Collects card data outside merchant application code

serviceProviders.responsibility: Confirm current service-provider evidence and merchant validation path

serviceProviders.paymentSecurityImpact: Can alter checkout code and deployment artefacts
serviceProviders.responsibility: Verify runner patching, isolation, workflow permissions, secret handling and cleanup

outcome.rawCardDataExposure: Raw card data does not appear able to touch merchant systems based on the evidence reviewed.
pciDependencies: Confirm the final validation pathway with the compliance-accepting entity.
businessLaunchRules: Confirm the merchant's accepted card brands and checkout configuration.
defenseInDepth: Protect the deployment branch and document self-hosted runner controls.
outcome.keyUncertainty: Operational access controls were described by the merchant but were not independently verified.

executiveSummary: The application uses Stripe-hosted payment fields and a server-created PaymentIntent.
Repository evidence supports a narrow card-data flow, but it cannot prove the merchant's annual validation obligations.

methodology: Reviewed the checked-out source at the recorded commit.
Compared material conclusions with current PCI SSC and Stripe primary sources.

paymentFlow.action: Loads the merchant checkout page and Stripe.js.
Collects PAN, expiry and CVC without exposing raw values to merchant code.

findings.title: Webhook signatures are verified before processing
findings.observation: The handler constructs the Stripe event from the raw body and signature header.
findings.consequence: Forged webhook payloads are rejected before order state changes.
findings.recommendation: Retain this control and monitor verification failures.
findings.verification: Replay a signed test event and confirm a 2xx response; send a modified signature and confirm rejection.
findings.confidence: High; exact source and test evidence were reviewed.
findings.counterEvidence: No contrary handler path was identified in the assessed source.

findings.title: Operational security responsibilities remain unverified
findings.observation: The repository does not establish account-access reviews, staff training or incident-response exercises.
findings.consequence: A sound payment integration alone cannot establish the merchant's overall PCI readiness.
findings.recommendation: Record owners and evidence for operational controls before formal validation.
findings.verification: Review dated access records, training evidence and the current incident-response procedure.
findings.confidence: High that repository evidence is insufficient; operational systems were not inspected.
findings.counterEvidence: No dated operational evidence was supplied during this review.

claimLedger.claim: Using Stripe alone determines SAQ eligibility.
claimLedger.evidence: Payment-data flow and the complete eligibility criteria must be assessed.
claimLedger.applicability: Applies to the web-ecommerce payment flow under review.
claimLedger.confidence: High; this is a qualified scope conclusion.

pciDependencies.action: Confirm the validation pathway and ASV applicability; do not describe an ASV as paid.
pciDependencies.verification: Written confirmation from the compliance-accepting entity

businessLaunchRules.action: Verify configured card-brand acceptance against the approved business policy
businessLaunchRules.verification: Stripe configuration evidence and successful sandbox test

defenseInDepth.action: Review self-hosted runner and failed webhook monitoring
defenseInDepth.verification: Alert and response evidence from the first month of operation

unknowns: Which entity will accept the merchant's PCI validation?
Are production Stripe roles reviewed on a documented schedule?
